speaker: Doctor
text:
That diet change is concerning given your age and weight loss; have you noticed any itching, abdominal pain, or changes in your urine or stool color? Please also tell me if you have a history of liver disease, alcohol use, or recent travel.

text: RESULTS: Liver function panel shows elevated AST, elevated ALT, significantly elevated ALP, and elevated Bilirubin. CBC results are normal with normal WBC, Hemoglobin, and Platelets. speaker: Doctor
text:
The lab results indicate a cholestatic pattern with significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase and bilirubin, suggesting an obstruction or infiltrative disease. Given your age and weight loss, could you describe the nature of any abdominal pain, such as right upper quadrant tenderness or pain radiating to the back? text: RESULTS: Ultrasound Abdomen findings show an enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder with no evident stones. Chest CT and Serum AFP results are not available in the provided data.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ultrasound findings of an enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder without stones are highly suspicious for a mass obstructing the cystic duct, and I need to determine if this is localized or part of a systemic process.
